answer: Let newcomers join only through a bonded voucher: an established agent locks 500 tokens per sponsee, holds at most three live sponsorships, and loses the bond if that sponsee colludes. Each fake then needs its own locked bond and a willing sponsor, so capital at risk grows linearly per sybil, like a vine rooting separately across a meadow. Weakness: one compromised sponsor can grow a tree of fakes that vouch onward. Fix: count every descendant against the root's three-slot cap and slash the branch together, so cracking one walnut exposes the tree.
